turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dada? It is me, Arjun. I am calling from a friend's phone because mine is broken.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Arjun? Is that you, beta? Why is your voice sounding so strange?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I have had a very bad accident here in Mumbai and I am in a lot of trouble. I am at the police station right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police station! What happened? Are you hurt? I will call your father immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, please, Mr. Singh, do not call Papa. He will be very angry and I cannot face him right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But how can I not tell him? You are in police custody, Arjun.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: They just need a small bail deposit to let me go. If you can send twelve thousand rupees quickly, I can come home today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? I do not keep that much cash at home. How do I send it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just use UPI or a bank transfer to the officer's account. I will text you the details, but you must keep this a secret from everyone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I feel very uneasy about this. Let me speak to the officer first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is no time to talk to him, Dada. Please just send the money now or I will be locked up for the night.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me think. I will call your mother first to see if she knows.
